statement: Find the equation of the circle passing through $A(1,0)$, $B(0,1)$ and $C(2,1)$.
solution:
Let the circle be $x^{2}+y^{2}+2gx+2fy+c=0$.
Substituting the three points:
\begin{align*}
A:&\quad 1+2g+c=0,\\
B:&\quad 1+2f+c=0,\\
C:&\quad 5+4g+2f+c=0.
\end{align*}
From A and B, $2g=2f$ so $g=f$, and $c=-1-2g$. Substituting into C:
$$5+4g+2g+(-1-2g)=0\quad\Rightarrow\quad 4+4g=0\quad\Rightarrow\quad g=-1.$$
Thus $f=-1$ and $c=1$. The circle is $x^{2}+y^{2}-2x-2y+1=0$, i.e. $(x-1)^{2}+(y-1)^{2}=1$.
